release_summary: New in this build: Steam support: the setup finds your Steam and Gameforge installs, or asks for the other one, and installs into both, with one Global Bank data folder and the Chrome extension in the Gameforge one; on Steam, ZShop's daily button skips Steam's browser, and Steam's characters show as a Steam account in Global Bank. Cherry's Info 1.0 (/cinfo, /cq) replaces Cherry's Quests, pbInfo, TooltipIds, PortraitHP and Extended Macro Icons, with one switch and one tabbed settings window; saved settings carry over. LogNextChar 1.3.1 includes Cherry's Loginxml, in one ZIP with its login screen. The guided setup (!setup_cherryskit.bat, at the root of the Full and Hub ZIPs) says which addons are out of date against this page's Latest release and updates them with the old versions kept, asks before installing anything your addons can use that's missing, maps Interface\AddOns, moves older copies and folders the kit no longer loads into Interface\offloaded_addons (nothing is deleted), stops the Global Bank helper during updates, puts the login screen in place and walks through the Chrome extension. Lighter and smaller: Cherry's Grid 1.1.6 makes next to no garbage while drawing, and the XML files of Cherry's Grid, Cherry's Chat and zBag went from 598, 401 and 229 KB to 105, 70 and 123 KB, with the same frames. A new Global Bank page and popup (Global Bank 1.6.0, extension 1.3.0): grouped pages down the side, the search and filters at the top of the Bank, a panel saying who holds an item and where, large, small or list layouts, one tight line for each character with Transfer stones and an Excluded list, a Gold overview that fits 200+ characters on one screen by Gameforge account, server and RoM account, with colours and tile sizes you can pick, and a new logo. The page's Terminal now runs in the helper itself, with the same commands and wording as its window. Global Bank 1.5.7 has a refreshed in-game window: server tabs, characters grouped by account, and a search that lights up the matching bag and bank slots, in an XML file of 113 KB. Global Bank 1.4.16 keeps same-named characters on different servers apart. Global Bank for RoM, the Chrome extension: the page is built for thousands of characters, with a Region button, server checkmarks (Ayvenas included), a Servers page to edit them, one selection on every page, the game's tooltips with item and mana stone stats, stacking checkmarks per item type, Always stack, a Favourites page, RoM account names, and an item menu that stacks the characters who hold it. Collecting the daily reward automatically is now a tick in the popup, off by default. It has a redesigned popup, and its heartbeat now really runs. Your macros and addon settings on the Global Bank page: a macro library with groups and a search, read from your characters' save folders, addon settings you can put back, newest and day-old backups, and an Import button in the game's macro window (Cherry's Info 1.0.3). The extension is ready for the Chrome Web Store: it says when the helper files are older than it, and explains what it needs when the helper isn't set up. zBag 5.07-ck19: type a stat name such as stamina in the bag or bank search and every item with that stat lights up, slot numbers show on the slot under the mouse (a tick in /zb shows them on every slot again), and searching #clean or #dirty finds mana stones without or with stats. Cherry's Chat 0.11.3: emoji typed with the Windows emoji panel are joined back together for Say bubbles, /cchat bubbletest shows what was sent, and colour-wrapped trade lines no longer show stray codes. rom weakauras 0.9.33: auras draw under your bags, bank and other windows (a Layer button puts them back on top), and icons from the Present buff and debuff templates show stack counts. Ultimate Mail Mod 7.0.1-ck12: History, Characters and Friends in the Mass Send recipient picker, and mass send no longer stops on items that never left their bag slot. Everything from 0.11.114 is included.
runtime_validation: Lua 5.1 simulated-client suite: 1236 tests; 1210 passed and 26 retired-editor tests skipped, none failing. New tests run the guided setup through its real launcher the way a double-click does, stop and restart a hidden helper, update from a build folder (checksums, ZIP paths, kept player files, merged addons), install the dependencies picked, and cover hub-only installs, a ZIP extracted into a folder of its own, folders the manifest no longer loads, merged addons' origins, Cherry's Info's tabs, the shared XML templates, the macro library, backups and in-game Import with made-up macros, and zBag's stat search. The Global Bank page, popup and web Terminal were driven with real clicks and keys in a headless Chrome on made-up characters, also against the real helper and local host in a private folder, and the extension was loaded for real in a throwaway Chrome. The release build verifies all 16 install packages, 204 manifest entries and 47 Markdown files, and refuses players' macro and backup files. The update route ran against GitHub's Latest release in a throwaway folder, and from the previous build in a throwaway game folder. Nothing has been confirmed in the game client yet; docs/TESTING.md lists the checks. Addon packages whose code didn't change keep their versions; only the generated requirement lines in their READMEs changed.

standalone_packages.title: LogNextChar
standalone_packages.summary: Next and Prev buttons that log you straight into the neighbouring character, with its own login screen: gets past a stuck server list, saved logins, keyboard controls.

origin.note: Install login screen.bat, or the guided setup, moves those folders to `Interface\offloaded_addons` for you, along with `CherrysKit\CherrysLoginxmlHook` from before Cherry's Loginxml became part of this addon. The login screen itself is Rom Autologin by Pyrrhus with fixes, and has to live in `Interface\loginxml`, the only place the game reads one: the same installer updates what is there, copies the old folder to `Interface\offloaded_addons` first, and keeps your saved logins.

works_with.for: shows each character's gold and last save on the character screen and the helper's status on the server screen, and gives it your account's character list, which boxes them together on its page and fills in their servers
closes its window before switching characters, as it does the game's mail window

standalone_packages.after_install: close the game and run `!setup_cherryskit.bat`, or double-click `Interface\AddOns\CherrysKit\LogNextChar\Install login screen.bat`. The game only reads a login screen from `Interface\loginxml`, so this copies it there. Until then, Next and Prev only log you out.
